name: Search
description: One web search and one page reader for every agent. Keyless first (your own SearXNG, DuckDuckGo, Wikipedia, Hacker News); Serper, Brave, Tavily, Exa or Jina when you add a key on the Models page. Optional reading services (Firecrawl, Jina Reader) for pages that come back empty, under Settings, Page reading.
